findings.title: Stats page error state has no retry; recovering requires changing dates or reloading
findings.steps: Sign in, open /stats while the API is unreachable or returns 5xx (or open /stats?from=2026-06-01&to=2026-01-01). Bring the API back.
findings.expected: Error message with a Try again button that refetches without a reload.
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is rendered; refresh() from useApiFetch is never exposed, so there is no retry control. The user has to edit a date or reload the page.
findings.evidence:
SSR HTML for /stats?from=2026-06-01&to=2026-01-01 contains only
The From date must be on or before the To date.
, and no retry button. stats.vue destructures only data/error/status.

findings.title: Stats request has no timeout, so a hung API leaves 'Loading stats…' up forever
findings.steps: Open /stats or change a date while the API accepts the connection but never responds.
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s and the page shows an error with retry.
findings.actual: useApiFetch/useApiClient set no timeout option, so the status stays 'pending' and 'Loading stats…' shows with no end.
findings.evidence: composables/useApi.ts: $fetch.create has no timeout; stats.vue passes only { query }.

findings.title: Raw validation text with internal field path shown for a bad date in a link
findings.steps: Open /stats?from=2026-02-30 (the URL regex accepts any NNNN-NN-NN).
findings.expected: A readable message such as 'From is not a valid date', and the input shows the bad value or falls back to the default.
findings.actual: Alert reads 'Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime, day value is outside expected range'. The date input can't show 2026-02-30, so it looks blank while the error refers to it.
findings.evidence: SSR HTML: <div class="alert alert--error" role="alert">Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime, day value is outside expected range

findings.title: Clearing a date field silently falls back to the current-year bound and can raise a confusing range error
findings.steps: Clear the From field, then set To to 2025-12-31.
findings.expected: A blank From is either refused with a visible reason or treated as unbounded.
findings.actual: The query drops 'from', so the server uses 2026-01-01 and returns 422 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' even though the user left From blank.
findings.evidence: API: GET /api/stats/harvests?to=2025-12-31 returns 422 with that detail, because the backend defaults a missing from to year_start.

findings.title: Months with no harvests are left out of the per-month table
findings.steps: Use the default 2026 range with the sample data.
findings.expected: One column per month of the chosen range, with zeros where nothing was harvested.
findings.actual: Only months that have harvests appear (2026-06 to 2026-09). A gap month in a wider range would vanish, which makes the table misleading.
findings.evidence: API response months: 2026-06, 2026-07, 2026-08, 2026-09 only. They are built from the distinct months in the harvest rows.
